853:t_1:4.en:
$$勝平$$
「Heh heh... Hearing myself called an ace like this makes me blush.」

853:t_1:5.en:
$$宇宙太$$
「Don't let it go to your head, $$勝平$$.」

853:t_1:6.en:
$$恵子$$
「That's right. $$勝平$$ may be the main one, but we're pilots of $$ザンボット３$$ too!」

853:t_1:7.en:
$$勝平$$
「Hah! Say what you like, but the guy riding $$ザンボエース$$ is the ace, literally! So there!」

853:t_1:10.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「They say the more you fight, the closer you are... Please keep doing your best with love, courage, and strength from here on.」

853:t_2:4.en:
$$万丈$$
「Thank you, AG. Sorry for making you go to the trouble.」

853:t_2:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「That composed attitude... Truly as expected of you.」

853:t_2:6.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「And at the same time, you show fierce anger toward the enemy... That's Mr. $$万丈$$ for you, the very picture of Mr. Dashing Fellow.」

853:t_2:7.en:
$$万丈$$
「If you understand that, then please refrain from any funny business, AG.」

853:t_2:8.en:
$$万丈$$
「For the sake of the world and its people, I don't intend to let evil ambitions go unpunished.」

853:t_2:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Understood. I'd hate to be torn apart like those iron bars myself.」

853:t_3:4.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Thanks, AG. Even coming from you, it feels good to get praised.」

853:t_3:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「How cruel...! To make such a discriminatory remark, when you're a president who stands above others!」

853:t_3:6.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Sorry...! I didn't mean it like that...」

853:t_3:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Now listen, Mr. $$ワッ太$$. A president's words have a strong influence on the employees.」

853:t_3:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「In any case, to get your employees going, you have to keep lighting a fire under them with your words! Even if you think, 'Being the boss is rough~'!」

853:t_3:9.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「If I lit a fire under them, I think everybody would hate it...」

853:t_4:4.en:
$$柿小路$$
「I did not earn this title through my strength alone. Please give each and every one of my employees a word of congratulations.」

853:t_4:11.en:
$$柿小路$$
「Now then, next, to my wife and 12 children, who have supported me...」

853:t_4:12.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Um... could you please cut me some slack? I'm actually quite serious...」

853:t_5:4.en:
$$正太郎$$
「I'm glad to hear you say that, but this isn't my strength alone.」

853:t_5:8.en:
$$正太郎$$
「Thank you, AG. I'm sure $$鉄人$$ is happy too.」

853:t_5:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Being able to say such things without a trace of embarrassment must be your strength, Mr. $$正太郎$$.」

853:t_6:3.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Happy Ace Pilot! Congratulations, Mr. $$ブラックオックス#pilot$$!」

853:t_6:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「What... words of congratulation aren't enough? Where did this kid pick up such cleverness...?」

853:t_6:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Yes, yes, I get it. Then here, this... Robovitan B, the robots' favorite!」

853:t_6:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「What... you've never heard of such a power-up part? Then are you saying you could eat wakame bread or Miss $$郁絵$$'s snacks!?」

853:t_6:11.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「But enough of that tactless nitpicking. Today I'll oil you myself, with all my heart. That will do, won't it, Mr. $$オックス$$?」

853:t_6:13.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(Dear me... Children are a handful, but they're so soothing...)

853:t_7:4.en:
$$グーラ$$
「Come no closer. There's something about you I just can't trust.」

853:t_7:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「What!? But $$ロビー$$, who used to be your subordinate, Mr. $$グーラ$$, was much the same sort!」

853:t_7:6.en:
$$グーラ$$
「That one also had ulterior motives, and a side I couldn't trust. I sense the same scent on you.」

853:t_7:7.en:
$$グーラ$$
「...Is what I'd like to say, but as the son of $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$, I have neither the right nor the qualification to say such a thing.」

853:t_7:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「If you have the attitude to admit your own faults and be humble like that, Mr. $$グーラ$$, you can walk alongside everyone.」

853:t_7:9.en:
$$グーラ$$
「Then you should learn some humility too.」

853:t_8:4.en:
$$タケル$$
「Thank you, AG. Thanks for all your hard work too.」

853:t_8:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「That refreshing smile and that consideration for others...! Truly the classic hero type!」

853:t_8:6.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「However, Mr. $$タケル$$... Selling love on the cheap is dangerous.」

853:t_8:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「In short, if you carelessly overuse the word 'ai' (love) far too much...」

853:t_8:9.en:
$$タケル$$
「If I overuse it, then what?」

853:t_8:10.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「You'll turn into an aye-aye, that long-tailed monkey of the southern island with the scary face when you look closely.」

853:t_8:11.en:
$$タケル$$
「What's that supposed to mean...! I wasted my time listening seriously.」

853:t_8:12.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(But you know, Mr. $$タケル$$... Excessive brotherly love can sometimes invite misunderstanding from the ladies. Please be careful.)

853:t_9:4.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「And while I'm at it, Happy Ace Pilot! Congratulations, Mr. $$ナオト$$, Mr. $$アキラ$$, Miss $$ミカ$$, and Miss $$ロゼ$$!」

853:t_9:5.en:
$$ナオト$$
「What's the deal, AG...? Are we just a bonus to our captain?」

853:t_9:6.en:
$$アキラ$$
「But if you're going to say that, hasn't the $$コスモクラッシャー$$ itself become a bonus to $$ゴッドマーズ$$ lately?」

853:t_9:7.en:
$$ミカ$$
「In terms of firepower, it does end up that way, but...」

853:t_9:8.en:
$$ケンジ$$
「What are you talking about? Our mission is to support $$タケル$$. Being a bonus is just fine.」

853:t_9:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Mr. $$ケンジ$$ is quite right. It is thanks to everyone's devoted efforts that Mr. $$タケル$$ is able to fight at all.」

853:t_9:10.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well... though there are those you could call the power of love.」
